independence: AHA pages one group; RCUK/ERC pages one group, both share ILCOR evidence. NIH and MSD are separately authored educational sources, MSD follows resuscitation guidelines. Royal Free hospital team and national guidance differ in authorship; same health-system origin disclosed. Manufacturer DailyMed label is not a second NIH guideline.
resolution: Accepted as source-bound independent editorial review after bilingual conditions/actions and14-dimensional content assessment; not clinical review or physician sign-off. Source access and shared-evidence limitations above remain disclosed.
